{"children":[["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"A: I just got some disappointing news about our event to launch our new organic energy drinks. The Glendale Conference Center, where we’re planning to hold the event, made an error and double-booked the room.
B: Does that mean they’re giving it to the other party?
A: Yes, because they held the initial booking. We have the option of changing the date or moving to a smaller room in the same venue.
B: Well, we’ve already sent out the invitations, so we’d better go with the smaller room. Could you call Glendale to let them know our decision? I’ll prepare some signs to redirect the guests upon arrival."}]]}]]}
